<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Outbound_Needs_Connection</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>An active outbound event needs a Connection and a Related Object.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>AND(Active__c, ISPICKVAL(Direction__c, "Outbound"), OR(ISBLANK(Connection__c), ISBLANK(Related_Object__c)))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>An active outbound event needs a Connection and a Related Object.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
